s1.title: 1. Introduction
s1.p1: Welcome to Cryptogen. These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of the Cryptogen platform, including our website, mobile applications, and all related services (collectively, the "Services") operated by Cryptogen Ltd, a company incorporated in England and Wales with company number 12345678, whose registered office is at 71-75 Shelton Street, Covent Garden, London, WC2H 9JQ, United Kingdom ("Company", "we", "us", or "our").
s1.p2: By accessing or using our Services, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree to these Terms, you may not access or use the Services.

s2.title: 2. Eligibility
s2.intro: To use our Services, you must:
items: Be at least 18 years of age
Be a resident of a jurisdiction where our Services are available
Complete our identity verification (KYC) process
Not be prohibited from using cryptocurrency services under applicable laws
Not be located in, or a citizen of, any jurisdiction subject to comprehensive sanctions

s3.title: 3. Account Registration
s3.intro: To access certain features of our Services, you must create an account. When creating your account, you agree to:
items: Provide accurate, current, and complete information
Maintain and promptly update your account information
Maintain the security and confidentiality of your login credentials
Accept responsibility for all activities under your account
Notify us immediately of any unauthorized access

s4.title: 4. Services Description
s4.intro: Cryptogen provides a platform for cryptocurrency portfolio management, including:
items: Secure cryptocurrency wallet management
Real-time portfolio tracking and analytics
Cryptocurrency deposit and withdrawal services
Market data and price information
Transaction history and reporting
s4.note: We reserve the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue any aspect of our Services at any time.

s5.title: 5. Fees and Payments
s5.p1: Certain Services may be subject to fees. All applicable fees will be displayed before you complete a transaction. Fees are non-refundable except as required by law or as expressly stated in these Terms.
s5.p2: Network fees for cryptocurrency transactions are determined by the respective blockchain networks and are separate from our service fees.

s6.title: 6. Risk Disclosure
s6.intro: Cryptocurrency investments involve significant risks, including but not limited to:
items: High price volatility and potential loss of value
Regulatory uncertainty and potential restrictions
Technology risks including software bugs and cyber attacks
Liquidity risks affecting the ability to buy or sell
Irreversibility of blockchain transactions
s6.warning: You should only invest what you can afford to lose. Past performance is not indicative of future results.

s7.title: 7. Prohibited Activities
s7.intro: You agree not to use our Services for:
items: Money laundering, terrorist financing, or other illegal activities
Fraud, deception, or misrepresentation
Circumventing any applicable laws or regulations
Interfering with the proper functioning of the Services
Accessing accounts belonging to others without authorization

s8.title: 8. Limitation of Liability
s8.content: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Cryptogen Ltd and its directors, employees, and affiliates shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, including loss of profits, data, or other intangible losses, resulting from your use of the Services.

s9.title: 9. Governing Law
s9.content: These Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of England and Wales. Any disputes arising from these Terms or your use of the Services shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales.

s1.title: 1. Introduction
s1.content: Cryptogen Ltd ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our platform and services. We are registered as a data controller with the UK Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) under registration number ZA123456.

s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
s2.personalIntro: We collect information you provide directly to us, including:
personalItems: Full name and date of birth
s2.autoIntro: When you use our Services, we automatically collect:

s3.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
s3.intro: We use the information we collect to:
items: Provide, maintain, and improve our Services
Verify your identity and comply with KYC/AML requirements
Process transactions and send related information
Send administrative messages and security alerts
Respond to your inquiries and provide customer support
Detect, prevent, and address fraud and security issues
Comply with legal obligations and regulatory requirements
Analyze usage patterns to improve user experience

s4.title: 4. Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR)
s4.intro: Under the UK GDPR, we process your data based on:
items: Contract: To fulfill our contractual obligations to you
Legal obligation: To comply with regulatory requirements
Legitimate interests: For fraud prevention and service improvement
Consent: For marketing communications (where applicable)

s5.title: 5. Data Sharing and Disclosure
s5.intro: We may share your information with:
items: Identity verification service providers
Payment processors and banking partners
Cloud hosting and infrastructure providers
Analytics and monitoring services
Legal and regulatory authorities when required by law
Professional advisors (lawyers, accountants, auditors)
s5.note: We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

s6.title: 6. International Data Transfers
s6.content: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries outside the UK and European Economic Area. When we transfer data internationally, we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place, including Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the UK ICO or adequacy decisions.

s7.title: 7. Data Retention
s7.content: We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to provide our Services and comply with legal obligations. Under UK anti-money laundering regulations, we are required to retain certain records for a minimum of 5 years after the end of our business relationship. Transaction records may be retained for up to 7 years for tax and regulatory purposes.

s8.title: 8. Your Rights
s8.intro: Under UK GDPR, you have the following rights:
items: Access: Request a copy of your personal data
Rectification: Request correction of inaccurate data
Erasure: Request deletion of your data (with certain exceptions)
Restriction: Request limited processing of your data
Portability: Receive your data in a structured format
Objection: Object to processing based on legitimate interests
Withdraw consent: Where processing is based on consent
s8.note: To exercise these rights, contact us at privacy@cryptogen.com. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO).

s9.title: 9. Security Measures
s9.content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data, including 256-bit SSL encryption, secure data centers, access controls, regular security audits, and employee training. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.whatAreDesc: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently, provide information to website owners, and enhance user experience. This policy explains how Cryptogen Ltd uses cookies and similar technologies.
cookies.howWeUseDesc: We use cookies for various purposes including:
howWeUseItems: Keeping you signed in to your account
Understanding how you use our platform
Improving our services based on usage patterns
Ensuring the security of your account

essential.name: Essential Cookies
essential.description: These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you such as logging in or filling in forms.

performance.name: Performance Cookies
performance.description: These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us know which pages are the most and least popular.

functional.name: Functional Cookies
functional.description: These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages.

marketing.name: Marketing Cookies
marketing.description: These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites.

cookies.thirdPartyDesc: Some cookies are placed by third-party services that appear on our pages. We use the following third-party services:
cookies.managingDesc: You can control and manage cookies in various ways:
cookies.browserSettingsDesc: Most browsers allow you to refuse cookies or delete existing cookies. Please refer to your browser's help documentation for instructions. Note that disabling cookies may affect the functionality of our platform.
cookies.cookieConsentDesc: When you first visit our website, you will be presented with a cookie consent banner. You can choose to accept all cookies or customize your preferences. You can change your preferences at any time through your account settings.
cookies.optOutLinksDesc: For Google Analytics, you can opt out using the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on available at:
cookies.retentionDesc: Session cookies are deleted when you close your browser. Persistent cookies remain on your device for a set period or until you delete them. Our persistent cookies typically expire after 12 months, though some security-related cookies may have shorter retention periods.
cookies.updatesDesc: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the updated policy on our website with a new "Last updated" date.
cookies.contactUsDesc: If you have questions about our use of cookies, please contact:

faq.a: Crypto deposits are typically confirmed within 10-30 minutes depending on network congestion. Bank transfers may take 1-3 business days.
Withdrawal limits depend on your verification level. Basic users can withdraw up to £1,000/day, while fully verified users have limits up to £100,000/day.

faq.q: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
faq.a: Go to Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication. You can use an authenticator app like Google Authenticator or receive SMS codes.

faq.q: Why is my verification taking so long?
faq.a: Most verifications complete within 24 hours. During high-demand periods, it may take up to 72 hours. Ensure your documents are clear and match your account details.
